day_shape: UK moves to designate IRGC and two linked bodies under state-threats law with FCDO sanctions on IMCR, CENTCOM claims first combat use of sea drones striking Bandar Abbas, Trump vows to restore Hormuz blockade, Saudi airstrikes hit Sana'a airport.

threads.label: UK designates IRGC under state threats law
threads.summary: UK ministers laid draft regulations under the National Security Act 2023 to designate the IRGC and two linked bodies, with the Foreign Secretary also sanctioning the Islamic Movement of Companions of the Right over attacks on Jewish locations. Defa Press called it the 'old fox's grudge settlement' against the IRGC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz US-Iran confrontation
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it struck a submarine and ship maintenance facility at Bandar Abbas using Corsair unmanned surface vessels in the first American combat use of sea drones, while Trump said the US would restore a naval blockade and take over the Strait. The IRGC spokesman and Khatam Al-Anbia rejected US interference, Iran's UK embassy announced a temporary secure maritime corridor, and Hormuz transits fell to multi-week lows.

threads.label: Saudi strikes on Sana'a airport
threads.summary: Saudi airstrikes hit runways and takeoff lanes at Sana'a International Airport, with Houthi officials vowing a response and threatening Saudi infrastructure. Yemen's armed forces spokesman said the attack ended the de-escalation phase.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral messaging cycle
threads.summary: IRIB and Khamenei's office pushed the Supreme Leader's message on the funeral of the 'martyred leader', with content on vengeance and traffic arrangements for the Imam Khomeini Square ceremony. Defa Press circulated a Lebanese Shia cleric's claim that Iran is at the start of 'new power'.

threads.label: Ahmadinejad and Mossad allegations
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported claims that Mossad sought to replace Khamenei with former president Mahmoud Ahmadinejad through 'very unique' special operations. A separate report said Ahmadinejad is under IRGC intelligence house arrest after authorities uncovered contacts with Israel.

threads.label: Gaza recovery funding and WFP incident
threads.summary: The UK announced £10 million for Palestinian-led early recovery in Gaza and joined an EU-led $1 billion coordination initiative on water, sanitation and health. A UN report said Hamas forcibly entered a WFP food site in Jabalia and assaulted two drivers, drawing UN condemnation that did not name Hamas.

threads.label: Regional axis coordination and posture
threads.summary: Iran hosted Hezbollah, Hamas and Houthi representatives during Khamenei's funeral week, per Jerusalem Post, while Pezeshkian met Russia's energy minister to declare rejection of unilateralism. Iran's foreign ministry said it would not fulfil MoU commitments until the US moves first, and the IDF Arabic spokesperson accused Hezbollah of converting Beaufort Castle into a stronghold with Iranian support.

events.title_en: The sword met the sword. Where is the terrorist Muhammad al-Deif? In the dustbin of history. Terrorist Hamas marks the second anniversary of the elimination of the criminal killer Muhammad al-Deif, who hid among civilians in the al-Mawasi area.
